description:
Accept a standing offer on an ENS name you own. Returns unsigned Seaport fulfillOrder() calldata.

When you submit this transaction, Seaport atomically:
- Pulls the offered WETH from the buyer's wallet
- Transfers the ENS name from your wallet to the buyer
- Pays the fees the offer was signed with out of the WETH you receive

You receive the offer amount minus those fees; the response states both, read from the signed offer. The buyer needs a live WETH balance and allowance — if either is missing the tx will revert; you'll have signed but the chain won't execute.

A bid settles the UNWRAPPED name: if your name is wrapped, unwrap it first (unwrap_name), then accept. Before accepting: Seaport moves the name and the fee itself (no conduit), so you must have approved Seaport on the BaseRegistrar — use approve_operator if needed — and granted each WETH allowance listed in the response's approvals. Use get_name_details to see the offer hash and confirm the highest offer.

orderHash.description: Seaport order hash of the buyer's offer to accept

walletAddress.description: Your wallet address (the seller). Must own the ENS name in the offer.

name: accept_offer
